actions.autoRejectExact: Reject at once on an exact ID match

expect.vettingOff: Vetting is off for this registration: the registration is confirmed and no vetting request is made.
expect.noVetting: This badge type is set to No vetting: the normal registration and badge process continues.
expect.blocked: Submissions for this badge type are refused until a workflow is allotted.
expect.configurationError: No active workflow is allotted: the request is saved with Configuration Error and the admins are alerted. Vetting is never skipped.
expect.normal: One request is created on this workflow, checked against the lists, and sent to the first stage's team.

result.title: Result

outcomes.badBadgeType: Badge type not on this registration

explain.underReview: Request <ref>{id}</ref> was created and sent to {team} at the {stage} stage, Pending Review. The attendee was emailed that the registration is under review; no badge yet.
explain.screeningHold: Blacklist match: request <ref>{id}</ref> is on Screening Hold until someone decides in Match Review. The attendee only sees “Under review”.
explain.autoRejected: Exact ID match on the blacklist with auto-reject on: request <ref>{id}</ref> was rejected at once. The attendee's email does not mention the list.
explain.configurationError: Request <ref>{id}</ref> was saved with Configuration Error; the admins were alerted. It waits until a workflow is allotted.
explain.noVetting: Vetting is off: the normal registration and badge process continues, no request.
explain.duplicate: Same submission received again: no second request (AC05).
explain.duplicateOf: Same submission received again: no second request (AC05). The first one made request <ref>{id}</ref>.
explain.blocked: Submissions are blocked until a workflow is allotted for this badge type.
explain.missing: Nothing was saved. Fill in the marked fields and submit again.
explain.badBadgeType: Choose one of this registration's badge types.

result.watchNote: Watchlist match ({level}): the request is marked for the reviewers and goes on as normal.
